lesson.menu_desc: O que dizer quando você não entende -- 28 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- Sorry, Can You Repeat?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 9 -- Sorry, Can You Repeat?
lesson.grammar_point: can / can't for ability and polite requests

listenings.text: Hi Ricardo, this is Paul. Sorry, the line here is very bad. Can you hear me? I repeat: the meeting is on Monday at nine, not at eight. If you can not hear me, please send me an email and I answer today. I speak slowly now: Mon-day, at nine, in the morning. Thank you.

Hi Ricardo. This is Diane, and this is my advice for you. In a meeting, when you do not understand, do not say nothing. Say: sorry, can you repeat that? Or: can you speak more slowly, please? Nobody thinks it is a problem. I do this in Spanish all the time, and I am a manager here. It is normal. See you on Monday.

extra_audio.text: The call starts and the line is bad. I do not understand the client. I say: sorry, can you repeat that? She speaks more slowly. Now I understand the day and the time.
